scope: Short same-source C1 pilot; no performance/adoption/global-frontier result
target: same Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 g16/b4 checkpoint as117

ordinary.ahead: original retained; no sequential single-step surrogate

speculative.intrinsic_source_metadata: unchanged SpecRunner transaction_rounds/verify_m1_rounds retained; no added tensor hashing/reference callback in performance

pilot.cooling: one fixed gap after owned reap/unload+resource check, before nextarm; outside clocks
pilot.stop_policy: Keep both signs; an obviously slower speculative result stops progression, never reclassifies or drops negative data

sampling.raw32: both local modes must equal qualified native fixture; external APIs may only expose usage/visible text

timing.request: client perf_counter immediately before HTTP POST through arrival of SSE [DONE]; includes server queue,prefill,draft,verify,commit,delivery and transport; excludes stream teardown afterDONE
timing.latency_p50: median request DONE-start per measured group → median3groups/arm → median3fresh arms/config in confirmation
timing.throughput: actual emitted completion tokens / (lastDONE-firstPOST); median3groups/arm → median3fresh arms/config
timing.old_first_text_interactivity: supplementary only; speculative bursts make it a delivery proxy, not GPU decode throughput

resource_owner.paging: original guard; no swapout/swap growth relaxation
resource_owner.samples: before/after each group outside clocks; startup every2s only; no added performance-window hooks
resource_owner.cleanup: direct Popen exact birth/PPID/listener, owned TERM/KILL+wait/reap, strict PID+port absence before nextfresh; no port-wide kill

long_stage.issue: VerifyTransaction uses existing actual K/V allocation and rejects off+T>capacity; merely raising engine.max_len/verify_capacity does not reserve KV
long_stage.requirements: New exact tokenized prompt fixture/own-prefill ordinary reference; independent argmax progression, same-frontier used128+lastlogits strict, literal prefix/history/inputs readonly, futuretailzero, budgets/EOS/lifecycle; then separate fresh performance. No carryover short PASS. NormalEOS retains real output count and reason, no forced128 claim.

historical_comparisons: Keep native15 and official oMLX none best compatible configuration medians as dated reference only. Do not pool old runs, raw-native-only screens, or MTP-slower configuration into a new Pareto claim. A promising candidate needs fresh compatible official none/native controls before C1/Pareto claims.
